Messages.Author: Khervin U. Cheng Chua
Messages.Body:
Body Bag and Stolen Police Cruiser both state that they're "only
usable by an anarch"... does this mean that they can only be equipped
by an anarch or could a non-anarch vampire equip these but not gain
any effects from them (until, perhaps, the vampire goes anarch later
on)? Should "only usable" = "requires" in this case?

Khervin

Messages.Author: salem
Messages.Body:
On 6 Jun 2003 20:00:30 -0700, to...@observatory.ph (Khervin U. Cheng
Chua) scrawled:



If it meant requires i am sure it would have bold text stating that as
the first line in the text box.

But then it would still need the 'only usable by an anarch' text to
stop your anarch bringing it out, and then one of your non-anarch
vampires taking it off them.

salem

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct. Any minion can equip with a Body Bag. Only Anarchs can use it.
Note that the Body Bag still counts as a Haven for any minion with it.
